ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.85:1 ratio of white pixels to black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric regions occupy the lateral fields of both lobes. The left lobe white region exhibits high-density black mottling at its medial boundary. The right lobe white region is highly uniform with two distinct, isolated black pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees, partially occluded by central water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges between 4 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distal sections of both lobes follow a concave upward curve leading to the extreme lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular black pixel clusters (focal spots) located in the medial-superior quadrant of the right lobe white field. One small circular high-intensity (white) protrusion visible in the mid-left white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the distal terminal tip of the right fluke lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The pair of isolated black dots on the right lobe forms a highly unique and distinctive 'bi-focal' pattern within the white pigmentation field.
